title: Fix the lessons left
prompt: The progress page shows how many lessons each learner still has to pass in a course. The function below was written for it, but the column has the wrong name and the wrong numbers. Fix `solve(completions)`.
rules: Return four columns, in this order: `learner_id`, `course_id`, `as_of_date` and `lessons_left`.
`lessons_left` is `lessons_total` minus `lessons_completed`, so 0 when the course is finished.
A missing count gives a missing `lessons_left`. Keep every row, duplicates included.
hints: Press Run and look at the last column's name and values. A learner with 1 of 2 lessons done shows -1.
`.alias(...)` names only the column it's attached to. Here that's `lessons_total`, not the result of the subtraction.
`alias` has to go on the finished calculation, so the subtraction needs its own brackets. Then check the order of the subtraction against the rule.
explanation: The starter has two bugs. `.alias("lessons_left")` is attached to `F.col("lessons_total")` only, so the name is lost inside the subtraction and the column gets a long generated name. Wrapping the calculation in brackets puts the name on the result. The subtraction is also the wrong way round: completed minus total is negative for anyone still working. The fix is `(F.col("lessons_total") - F.col("lessons_completed")).alias("lessons_left")`. `selectExpr("learner_id", "course_id", "as_of_date", "lessons_total - lessons_completed AS lessons_left")` is the same.
